desc: the default thread count is one
the sync is off by default and on with --no-sync
the scale-down is on by default
the default codec is tagged
--spill-kb is read in thousands of bytes
new: SpillBytes = I("spill-kb") is { } sk ? sk * 1000 : null,

desc: --chunk sets the chunk slots of PH1
--k-s sets the bucket capacity of PH3
the PH5 arena cap is read in KiB
the packed text is not compared with its reference
the suffix array is not compared with its reference
a difference does not fail the run
LRS_RANK is not compared
the overflow list is not compared
the exit code needs only one of the RssAnon cap and a clean run
old: bool ok = res.RssAnonPeakMb <= o.Double("rss-cap-mb", RssCapMb) && res.Clean;
new: bool ok = res.RssAnonPeakMb <= o.Double("rss-cap-mb", RssCapMb) || res.Clean;

desc: the default RssAnon cap is 25,600 MB
the CHILD bytes are 4 n instead of 4 (n + 1)
total_s is the wall time of the whole run
the text file holds the dense codes instead of the letters
the hash comparison accepts any hash
the SA stage row is the total
ns per symbol uses the wall time
the output footprint leaves out the metadata files
the packed codec is selected by --codec tagged
the exact flag is not read
